BrochureContent.Content:
REA Donohoe Spring are delighted to bring to the market this Spacious 4 Bed, 2.5 Storey Semi-Detached Residence in a Prime Location, Short Walking Distance of Cavan Town Centre. Ideal Home or Rental Investment. Commercial/Office Potential Subject to Planning. For Sale by Private Treaty. 

 

Offers excellent opportunity for house hunters seeking a convenient town centre living location or those looking for a buy to let investment property. Redevelopment opportunity into apartments or change of use to offices (Subject to appropriate planning permission).

 

Built in C. 1960 and of standard construction with tile roof, plaster exterior finish and uPVC double glazed windows. Connected to all mains services and with oil fired central heating. There is off street parking to front and an enclosed courtyard garden area to the rear. Fibre broadband area. BER: E1. Freehold Folio CN5626F.

 

Laid out of 3 floors extending to C. 117 sqm / 1,259 sqft, the accommodation comprises of;

Ground Floor:

Entrance Hall (1.8 x 1.8)

Bedroom 4 (5.5 x 3.9) with under stair storage (0.7 x 1.3)

W.C. (1.8 x 1.6).

 

1st Floor: 

Landing (2.5 x 2.8)

Bedroom 1 (2.6 x 2.5)

Open plan Kitchen/Diner/Living Room (3.2 x 8.3) with patio door to rear courtyard

Utility room (2.6 x 2.5) Shower Room (1.2 x 2.5).

 

2nd Floor:

Landing (2.5 x 2.1) with eaves storage Hot Press

Bedroom 2 (3.2 x 2.9), Shower Room (2.2 x 1.7)

Bedroom 3 (3.3 x 3.4) with Built-in Wardrobe.

 

Ideally located within walking distance to Cavan Bus Station Town Centre. Convenient to shops, restaurants, schools, hotels, cultural sports amenities and all amenities Cavan town has to offer. Under 90 minutes drive to M50 Dublin. GPS: 53.991298, -7.366268

 

Viewing Highly Recommended Strictly By Appointment Only.
